# Example project files from Smith V4.1

The 22 `.xmlsc` files in this folder are the example projects shipped with
**Smith V4.1** by Prof. Fritz Dellsperger (http://www.fritz.dellsperger.net/smith.html),
taken unchanged from the author's `Examples V4.1.zip` (files dated October 2016).

They are the work of Fritz Dellsperger and are used here only as test fixtures:
Smith Online must load each file without error, re-save it byte-compatibly and
reproduce the stored datapoint values. They are not covered by this project's
MIT license. The installer, help files and example PDF are not redistributed.

| Files | Content |
|---|---|
| Example1.xmlsc to Example12.xmlsc | basic matching examples |
| Example13-input.xmlsc, Example13-output1 to output3 | datapoint sweep example |
| Example14-1.xmlsc, Example14-2.xmlsc | two variants of one design |
| Example15.xmlsc to Example18.xmlsc | sweeps and circles |

See `docs/01-original-analysis.md` for the file format and what each example covers.
